text:
Maya: Uploaded two prototypes for first-run sample discovery: a centered micro-modal spotlight that briefly appears after signup vs an inline "mini-rail" pinned to the right of the checklist. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/proto-spotlight (frames 'Spotlight Modal' & 'Mini-Rail'). Which gives better discoverability without overwhelming the checklist?

Jess: Love the modal for visibility, but it's modal-heavy. It could interrupt users trying to finish the checklist. Metrics idea: run a short experiment measuring sample_start within first 10 minutes of session for modal vs mini-rail.

Dan: Mini-rail is less disruptive and keeps checklist momentum. Concern: users might ignore it entirely if it looks like an ad. Need clear affordance and accessible headline.

Kofi: Microcopy suggestion: CTA options we should test: "Launch sample", "Try example", "Spin up demo". My vote is "Launch sample" — action-forward and not too casual. Short variant for mobile: "Launch".

Priya: Accessibility quick scan: the modal must trap focus while open and return focus to the originating element on close. For the mini-rail, the toggle needs aria-expanded and aria-controls. Both need visible focus states and 44px touch targets. Also contrast: the modal CTA in the mock is 3.8:1 on the background image; bump to 4.5:1.

Maya: Good catches. UX flow idea: show modal only once (first session) with a "Don't show again" checkbox which persists per-account. Mini-rail is the persistent fallback thereafter. Thoughts?

Jess: That hybrid is smart. A quick funnel: modal_impression -> modal_launch -> checklist_continue. If modal is dismissed, show mini-rail impression -> rail_launch. Capture both.

Dan: Implementation note: tagging elements with data-qa attributes will make analytics and e2e easier: data-qa="onboard-spotlight-cta", data-qa="onboard-mini-rail-toggle", data-qa="onboard-sample-cta". Also ensure keyboard can focus into the rail on open.

Kofi: For enterprise orgs, default modal = off. Admins can enable it org-wide. Add an org setting: onboarding.samples_modal = true/false. Users can override per-account.

Priya: Screen reader specifics: when modal appears, announce it with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" and include aria-label or aria-labelledby. For mini-rail, use role="complementary" and ensure aria-live="polite" on the status region when a sample is started.

a11y-bot: Automated check: in "Spotlight Modal" frame, close button missing aria-label attribute. Recommendation: add aria-label="Close sample spotlight". Also flagged low contrast on small caption over image in mini-rail.

Maya: I'll update Figma: 1) add focus trap notes & close focus return for modal, 2) increase CTA contrast to meet 4.5:1, 3) add aria labels/roles as callouts, 4) include a "Don't show again" control in modal copy. Will post updated frames by tomorrow.

Jess: Analytics: I'll add events modal_impression, modal_launch, modal_dismiss, rail_impression, rail_launch, sample_complete. Also capture activation method (keyboard vs pointer) and session_first_visit boolean.

Dan: Dev constraints: images in modal and rail should lazy-load; keep modal lightweight. For mini-rail, ensure it collapses responsively on narrow viewports beneath the checklist rather than overlaying content.

Kofi: Also recommend a tiny tooltip "What are sample projects?" linked from both variants. Make tooltip accessible with aria-describedby and keyboard focus.

Priya: Motion/accessibility: any entrance animation must respect prefers-reduced-motion. For the modal, if user prefers reduced motion, use an instant fade-in or no animation.

Maya: I'll include two microcopy variants in Figma: "Launch sample" and "Try example". We'll run a copy test as part of the experiment. I'll also add a 6-step keyboard usability script and mark nodes with data-qa for dev handoff.

Jess: Sounds good. Can we run a small pilot (1k users per arm) and check early signals before broader rollout?

Maya: Yes. Pilot then iterate. I'll drop updated exports and the script in #design-review once done. Thanks!

Dan: :thumbsup:

Kofi: One tiny note on localization: short copy like "Launch" might not translate well. Add length checks in Figma notes for common locales.

Priya: And include SR walkthrough steps in the Figma annotations (where focus moves, what gets announced).

Maya: Will do. Follow-up: I'll open a tiny PR suggestion for focus order and add data-qa markers for e2e tests.
